title: change_trust that sets an existing trustline's limit to its current value (INT64_MAX): the trustline is written back unchanged
caps_note: No CAP applies: a classic operation that predates CAPs.
why: Transaction 24846775… is a change_trust on an existing COPPER trustline with the limit it already has (9223372036854775807). stellar-core writes the trustline back with the same limit, balance and flags (only last_modified_ledger_seq moves), so no trustline limit change happened. A reader that builds a limit change from the operation body instead of comparing the entry before and after records an update that did not happen.

variants.notes: Real pubnet ledger with 400 transactions at Protocol 29; this entry's pattern is transaction 124 in apply order. Written by stellar-core 30.0.0 at the same protocol era, so it is not marked regenerated.

notes: Input of finding F-0072 (TRUSTLINE UPDATE). Expected: no trustline_limit_changed for the operation (state_changes_exact with no operation-level item).
